##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 05 November 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the north of Scotland, drifting eastwards and slowly declining.


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, decreasing east 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate at first, becoming smooth or slight overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then occasional rain later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in any rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East 2 to 4, becoming variable 3 or less.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
